title: Chaos Enchats
description: Interesting custom enchantments using the new attributes from the chaos cubed drop
body:
Interesting custom enchantments using the new attributes from the chaos cubed drop

Currently adds the following enchants:
Aerodynamic : Chest armor
Bouncyness: feet armor
Sliperyness: feet armor

Each has 5 levels.  
Using them in combination can have some interesting effects ;)
